description: This source file is a Markdown documentation describing the PlaywrightAssertions class and its methods, used for writing assertions in Playwright testing across multiple languages. It provides explanations, usage examples, and details about available assertion methods for various types like API responses, locators, pages, and generic values.

classes.name: PlaywrightAssertions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating assertions and configuring timeout settings for Playwright-based tests across multiple programming languages.

methods.name: expectAPIResponse
methods.description: Creates an assertion object for an API response, allowing tests to verify the response's properties and status.

methods.name: expectGeneric
methods.description: Creates a generic assertion object for a given value, useful for asserting properties of arbitrary data.

methods.name: expectLocator
methods.description: Creates assertions for a given Locator object, to verify its state or properties.

methods.name: expectPage
methods.description: Creates assertions for a given Page object, such as checking the page title or URL.

methods.name: setDefaultAssertionTimeout
methods.description: Changes the default timeout for assertions from 5 seconds to a specified value.
